what: Clicking a link box floats an identical box in place, its inner text fades out in .2s, then, pinned at the top left, it grows to the next page’s panel size (default 60vw × 94vh) over .6s power4.inOut and then navigates to that URL. If the next page places a panel of the same color in the same spot, the clicked box simply becomes the next page. In the bento cell grid each cell has its own panel size (About 70% × 94vh, Team 60vw × 94vh, 30% × 47vh when returning to the first page)

options.dur: Growth duration (seconds), default .6 — shorten it for screens that are flipped often (0 goes immediately)
options.wait: Time before moving on once fully grown (s), default 0
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or 0.76,0,0.24,1, default power4.inOut
options.[data-fx-part=box]: (if present) the box that grows — otherwise the element with the part attached grows. The link is that element or the first a[href] inside it

use: Who we are …

from.where: shared.js transitions (indextoabout red box → 70% × 94vh · indextoteam wordmark cell → 60vw × 94vh · abouttoindex red panel → 30% × 47vh, all power4.inOut .6s) — like the original, the site swaps the page in via Highway, and the motion parts are generalized to open the page fresh

note: The original is a single-page app (Highway), so only the panel is swapped and the new panel stands right behind the grown box. The part opens a fresh page, so the next page must place the same panel in the same spot for it to look continuous.
